cves.description: Winbox directory traversal allowing unauthenticated read of arbitrary files, including user database — the flaw at the root of the Meris and several other botnets.
RouterOS proxy/DNS can be abused for SSRF and reflected attacks against internal hosts.
Privilege escalation from a low-privileged user to full admin via the Winbox/HTTP interface; hundreds of thousands of devices remained exposed to this well after patches shipped.
